cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team at HR Tech Co,

I am writing to express my strong enthusiasm for the Growth Marketer role at HR Tech Co. Having spent the last 6+ years at the intersection of B2B growth marketing, AI systems architecture, and sales operations, I have seen firsthand how generative AI and agentic workflows are completely transforming demand generation.

Most recently, as an AI-Native Product Lead and Systems Architect, I engineered the AI Career OS and lead GTM motions where I orchestrated LLMs (Claude, GPT), created signal-based personalization engines, and partnered closely with technical builders to deliver high-velocity releases. Previously, at Wipro (Meta Project), I led GTM enablement and ABM frameworks across 150+ professionals, scaling CRM AI adoption to rank #1 globally (+150%).

What excites me most about HR Tech Co is the opportunity to own GTM strategy, shape the AI-driven growth playbook (AEO, de-anonymization, multi-channel prospecting), and partner directly with your GTM Engineer to translate high-level growth strategy into concrete, high-converting technical motions.

I would love the opportunity to discuss how my hands-on experience with AI workflows, ABM strategies, and CRM data pipelines can help HR Tech Co accelerate its next phase of growth.

Best regards,
Kevin Augusto Vieira

form_answers.question: Why are you interested in this role at HR Tech Co?
form_answers.answer: I am passionate about how AI is fundamentally restructuring B2B GTM motions. This role perfectly unites my background in B2B demand gen, ABM playbooks, and hands-on AI systems architecture alongside GTM Engineers.

form_answers.question: Describe your experience partnering with technical teams or GTM Engineers.
form_answers.answer: In my recent projects (AI Career OS and Meu Barzin), I defined the product specs, prompts, and data schemas while working directly with engineering pipelines, ensuring fast feedback loops, strict data validation, and zero-hallucination user experiences.
